comment_text.value:
Interested to give this a try. I've tried Wispr Flow and found it to be quite good, but a bit pricey for my taste. I guess I assumed there were equally good models that were cheaper, and I suppose this is one of them.

I'll be curious to see how the existence / popularity of tools like this end up affecting the pricing of paid tools like Wispr Flow.
